cover.concept: Two winding ribbon-shaped light trails in muted indigo line work, one made of small square tiles evoking a social feed, the other shaped like a search bar with a small magnifying-glass tip. The two ribbons curve toward each other from opposite sides and merge into a single bright accent-orange thread exactly where they meet, that merged thread continuing on alone past the meeting point while the two separate trails fade out behind it.

inline.name: platform-bridge
inline.concept: A simple geometric hand silhouette in muted indigo line work plugging a glowing accent-orange cable from a small phone shape — its screen showing a stack of scrolling square tiles — into a laptop shape whose screen shows a single flat search-bar icon. A small burst of light in accent orange marks the exact point where the cable connects.

inline.name: topic-signal
inline.concept: A grid of small identical square tiles in muted indigo outline, evenly spaced, with only two of the tiles rendered in solid bright accent orange. A thin orange line rises from each of those two brighter tiles and converges upward into a single small search-bar icon floating above the grid, while the rest of the grid stays flat and unconnected below.
